http_return_codes.5xx_rule: HTTP 5XX return codes are used for internal errors; the issue is on Binance's side. If there is an error message "Request occur unknown error.", please retry later.

503_variants.msg: Unknown error, please check your request or try again later.
503_variants.quote: the API successfully sent the request but not get a response within the timeout period. It is important to NOT treat this as a failure operation; the execution status is UNKNOWN and could have been a success
it means this is a failure API operation and the service might be unavailable at the moment, you need to retry later

503_variants.msg: Internal error; unable to process your request. Please try again.
503_variants.quote: it means this is a failure API operation and you can resend your request if you need

503_variants.msg: Request throttled by system-level protection. Reduce-only/close-position orders are exempt. Please try again.
503_variants.quote: This indicates the node has exceeded its maximum concurrency and is temporarily throttled. Close-position, reduce-only, and cancel orders are exempt and will not receive this error.
